content.title: About
content.content: Overripe raw bananas are fully matured fruits of the banana plant (Musa spp.) that have passed the optimal ripeness stage, becoming very soft, fragrant, and sweet. They are commonly used in baking, smoothies, and desserts where natural sweetness and moisture are desired.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Overripe bananas contain more sugars than ripe ones due to starch conversion.
Bananas are one of the few fruits that provide a notable amount of vitamin B6.
Among fruits, bananas have the highest potassium content.
Overripe bananas are a classic ingredient for banana bread and pancakes.
Banana peels contain antioxidants but are rarely eaten.

items.title: Rich in potassium
items.content: Potassium supports normal blood pressure and muscle function.

items.title: Source of vitamin B6
items.content: Vitamin B6 is involved in protein metabolism and neurotransmitter synthesis.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion and helps maintain satiety.

items.title: Natural sugars
items.content: Overripe bananas provide a quick source of energy thanks to simple sugars.

items.title: Antioxidant compounds
items.content: Bananas contain dopamine and vitamin C, which help combat free radicals.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Overripe bananas can raise blood sugar quickly, which is important for people with diabetes.

items.title: Allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience an allergic reaction to bananas.

items.title: Excess potassium
items.content: Large amounts may be problematic for those with kidney disease requiring potassium restriction.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Add overripe bananas to bread and cake batters, blend into smoothies, mash for baby food, or use as a natural sweetener in sauces and desserts.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep bananas at room temperature until fully overripe, then refrigerate where they will last up to 5 days. Freeze peeled chunks for later use in smoothies and baking.
